abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Northgate Heart Cohort.
